name: Riverside Majestic Hotel — Puteri Wing
location: Jalan Tunku Abdul Rahman, 93100 Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia

heroMedia.alt: Riverside Majestic Hotel Puteri Wing commanding the Kuching riverfront

story: Soaring above the heart of Sarawak's capital, the Puteri Wing of Riverside Majestic Hotel offers 5-star international refinement. Blending stately comfort, the esteemed Puteri Grand Ballroom, and panoramic river vistas, it serves as the chosen address for high-level delegations, corporate leaders, and leisure connoisseurs.

rooms.name: Puteri Superior Room
rooms.description: Ergonomic sophistication featuring modern timber finishes, plush bedding, high-speed connectivity, and an executive work hub.

rooms.name: Puteri Deluxe River View
rooms.description: Commanding high-floor panoramas across the winding Sarawak River, historic Fort Margherita, and golden sunsets.

rooms.name: Puteri Executive Club Suite
rooms.description: An opulent suite featuring a dedicated conference table, private living room, marble bathroom with whirlpool tub, and exclusive Club Lounge privileges.
